rubric.1: Incoherent, mere names, or only a broad domain in common.
rubric.2: Mixed scientific subthemes without a sufficiently unified specific concept.

rubric.scope: Personal reading of all 15 supplied member texts in each packet. Ratings concern sampled evidence only, not unseen members. Materials science, type similarity, and name similarity alone are insufficient. No web or other project files consulted. Uncertainty describes ambiguity of the sampled evidence; all packets additionally have sampling uncertainty.
